summary: All 64 one-to-one gene matches agreed in direction with the registered PLX3397-versus-vehicle result: 16 increased and 48 decreased. Of the 65 genes in the authors’ heatmaps, Fam205a2 remained unpaired because its registered coefficient also includes Fam205a4. Among the 64 paired genes, 44 met registered FDR < 0.05. [Published Figure 3](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41380-023-02326-2/figures/3)
openIssues: The public figure establishes selected-gene directions only. Author effect sizes, gene-level RNA-seq P values and FDR, and genome-wide agreement remain unassessed.
The exact author design, including sex adjustment and library-to-litter assignments, remains unresolved.
The separate QC summary reports 479 discoveries. The registered DE table and its model provenance both give 478. The comparison uses the registered DE table.
